patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts within sections, often pairing a large product image with a concise text block, creating dynamic visual balance.
Extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings are used for all major section titles, creating a declarative and impactful visual hierarchy.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates the site, with product photography often serving as the primary visual element against these stark backgrounds.
Content sections and their internal elements (images, text blocks) reveal with a subtle fade-up and slide-in animation as they scroll into the viewport.
Each major content theme (e.g., 'Award-Winning Eyewear', 'The Technology') is presented as a distinct, full-width section, separated by generous vertical spacing and a prominent, oversized heading.

technique_notes: Content sections are animated into view using a scroll-triggered reveal system (like AOS), where elements slide up and fade in with a slight delay as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
The primary navigation bar is designed to stick to the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, maintaining accessibility to key site sections without visual transformation.
Hero sections combine a full-bleed, high-resolution product image with oversized, uppercase typography for a bold and immediate brand statement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif headings (approx. 3-5x body text size) with smaller, regular-weight body text and uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly right-angled elements and sharp corners on interactive components).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample internal padding, creating a sense of luxury and clarity).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold, high-contrast aesthetic, driven by a stark black and white palette and the consistent use of extremely large, uppercase typography. This, combined with dramatic product photography, elevates the smart eyewear to a luxury item rather than a typical tech gadget.
